title: SPARC Cat - Sham Control Chronic Cat 2, Day 0
author: Brett Hanzlicek
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfzcjp2w
materials: Transport cat from housing site to surgery site.
Empty Bladder Cat transitioned back to isoflurane

steps.title: Prepare animal for surgery
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the cat, shave the abdomen, and move the animal to the surgery room to be attached to monitors.

steps.title: Sterilize surgical site
steps.instruction: Drape the animal and perform a betadine scrub on the abdomen and genitals.

steps.title: Insert bladder catheter
steps.instruction: Insert a 3.5Fr catheter lubricated with surgilube into the bladder through the urethra.

substeps.instruction: Advance the catheter until resistance is met

steps.title: Collect urine sample
steps.instruction: Use gentle suction with a syringe to withdraw urine from the bladder through the catheter.

steps.title: Visualize bladder via CT
steps.instruction: Use a 1:5 dilution of contrast to saline to visualize the bladder through sequential CT imaging.

substeps.instruction: Fill bladder with 10 mL contrast and take a single CT image
Add 10 mL more (total 20 mL) and take a single CT image
Add 10 mL more (total 30 mL) and take a single CT image
Take a 3D CT image with 30 mL contrast:saline in the bladder

steps.title: Perform pressure recording
steps.instruction: Transfer cat from Isoflurane to propofol anesthetic and record bladder pressure using Labview software and an external pressure transducer connected to a syringe pump.

substeps.instruction: Set fill rate to 2 mL saline/minute using syringe pump
Fill bladder with saline and record pressure at the following volumes: 8.6 mL, 11.5 mL, 12.8 mL, 15.5 mL, and 18.2 mL

steps.title: Insert device into bladder
steps.instruction: Access and open the bladder for device insertion following the 'SPARC Cat surgery Day 0' protocol.

substeps.instruction: Suture the bladder closed with 4-5 stitches
Add 25 mL of dilute contrast through the catheter

steps.title: Perform post-insertion imaging
steps.instruction: Take a picture with DYNA-CT and a 3D CT.

steps.title: Remove device and close
steps.instruction: Remove stitches from the bladder and remove the device.

substeps.instruction: Suture the bladder and abdomen according to the 'SPARC Cat surgery Day 0' protocol

steps.title: Post-operative bladder filling
steps.instruction: Fill the bladder with saline at a rate of 2 mL/min.

steps.title: Recovery
steps.instruction: Wait for the cat to wake up and return it to the housing site.

steps.title: Final pressure recording
steps.instruction: Fill the bladder with saline and record pressure using the pressure transducer connected to LabView.
